sources.title: Finally, a Replacement for BERT: Introducing ModernBERT
sources.snippet: Since ModernBERT is a Masked Language Model (MLM), you can use the fill-mask pipeline or load it via AutoModelForMaskedLM. To use ModernBERT for downstream tasks like classification, retrieval, or QA, fine-tune it following standard BERT fine-tuning recipes. ⚠️ If your GPU supports it, we recommend using ModernBERT with Flash Attention 2 to reach the highest efficiency. sources.title: fast-bert · PyPI
sources.snippet: Language Model Fine-tuning A useful approach to use BERT based models on custom datasets is to first finetune the language model task for the custom dataset, an apporach followed by fast.ai's ULMFit. The idea is to start with a pre-trained model and further train the model on the raw text of the custom dataset.
